snippet.title: Live Hard, Die Hard | 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Busy but Addictive! 
This BATTLE x MEDICAL Counter-Invasion Real-Time Strategy is like nothing you've ever seen! 
An army of aliens is here to invade the Earth! 
Show the Earth-style greeting to those unwanted visitors who lounge around our grounds! 
Lead your troops to extinguish zillions of aliens!
